title: A Letter From The Office Of The 1St Propaganda Corps Of The Chihli-Shantung Allied Forces Of The Ankuochun Army

page_data.en:
Form 81
V.P.-500 11-26.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of a letter from the office of the 1st Propaganda Corps of
the Chihli-Shantung Allied Forces of the Ankuochun Army,
No. 5 Chefoo Road.
February 20, 1927.

I have to inform you that I am in receipt of an order
of appointment from the 1st Propaganda Corps of the Chihli-
Shantung Allied Forces of the Ankuochun Army (Peace Restoration
Army), as follows :-
" Cho Wu-tso (卓武初) is appointed Chief of
the Shanghai Office of the 1st Propaganda Corps
of the Chihli-Shantung Allied Forces of the
Ankuochun Army and a seal with an inscription
to the above effect is issued to him accordingly".

In compliance with the above mentioned order I have
established an office at No. 5 Chefoo Road in your Settlement
on February 20 and assumed office on the same date.
Apart from reporting to my superiors and notifying others,
I have to write this letter to you in the hope that you will
take note, thus obliging.

(Sd) Cho Wu-tso (卓武初).
Chief of the Shanghai Office of
the 1st Propaganda Corps of the
Chihli-Shantung Allied Forces of
the Ankuochun Army.

This is to Commissioner of Police Barrett,
International Settlement.
page_data.zh:
表格 81
V.P.-500 11-26.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总巡官办公室。

安国军直鲁联军第一宣传队（地址：芝罘路5号）来函译文。
1927年2月20日。

兹通知阁下，本人已收到安国军（即“和平救国军”）直鲁联军第一宣传队的委任令，内容如下：
“任命卓武初为安国军直鲁联军第一宣传队上海办事处主任，并颁发刻有上述职衔之印信一枚。”

遵照上述命令，本人已于2月20日在贵租界芝罘路5号设立办事处，并于同日就职。除向上级呈报及通知各方外，特致函阁下，希予知照，不胜感激。

（签名）卓武初。
安国军直鲁联军第一宣传队
上海办事处主任。

此致
国际租界警务处总巡官巴雷特先生。

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REQ
No. 7645
Date 25/2/27

February 23,

TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN.

The bearer, Mr. F. C. Soo, Chief Secretary
of the Lecturing Corps, Ankuochun, who are desirous
of giving lectures to labourers and others on the
evils of Bolshevism. To this there are no Police
objections. He has been given to understand that
this can only be done with the consent of employers.

Deputy Commissioner of Police.

（批：Noted & returned!
24/2/27
Unltd
25/2/27.）

2月23日，

致有关人士：

持函人苏先生（F. C. Soo），系安国军宣讲团首席秘书。该团拟向劳工及其他人士宣讲布尔什维主义之危害。警方对此无异议。已告知持函人，此类活动须在获得雇主同意后方可进行。

副警务总监。

（批注：已知悉并退回！
